title: Seller's Real Estate Transfer Disclosure
description: Utah Code §57-1-37 requires sellers of residential real property to provide a written seller disclosure to the buyer. The disclosure must identify known material defects in the property including structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and environmental conditions. Utah follows a seller's actual knowledge standard — sellers are not required to conduct inspections but must disclose what they know.

required_actions.note: Disclosure must be provided prior to closing. Buyer should conduct independent inspections.

title: Agency Disclosure and Limited Agency
description: Utah requires licensees to disclose their agency relationship in writing. Utah recognizes limited agency (dual agency) when both parties give written informed consent. The Utah Division of Real Estate requires use of the approved agency disclosure form at the beginning of any substantive relationship.

required_actions.note: Must be provided before the buyer or seller is obligated under a contract.

title: Closing Practice — Title Company/Escrow
description: Utah is not an attorney-close state. Closings are typically handled by title companies or escrow officers. Utah uses a trust deed system rather than traditional mortgages. Title insurance is standard practice.

required_actions.note: Title company or escrow agent conducts closing. Trust deed system used.

citations: Utah Code Ann. §57-1-19 et seq. (trust deeds)

title: Lead-Based Paint Disclosure (Pre-1978)
description: Federal law requires disclosure of known lead-based paint hazards for residential properties built before 1978. Utah follows federal requirements. Sellers must provide the EPA pamphlet and allow a 10-day inspection contingency period.

title: Underground Storage Tank Disclosure
description: Utah sellers must disclose knowledge of any underground storage tanks on the property. The Utah Department of Environmental Quality maintains a registry of USTs, and contamination from leaking USTs may require remediation under Utah Code §19-6-402 et seq.

required_actions.note: Disclose presence, age, and condition of any underground storage tanks. Check DEQ registry.
